functionalRequirement: System shall calculate modification charges based on modifying time, date, route, availability, display new fares, and process payments through the payment gateway.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must accurately calculate modification charges based on time, date, route, and availability, and display the new fares for 100% of valid modification requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to handle complex calculations and display results, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that the calculated modification charges are accurate within 0.01% of the expected value for 99.9% of valid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves financial transactions, which require high precision and correctness.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must calculate modification charges and display new fares within 500 milliseconds for up to 500 concurrent requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time calculations and display, requiring timely responses for a good user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 100 MB of memory to process a single modification request.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for handling multiple concurrent requests and maintaining system performance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive interface for users to input modification details and view the new fares, with clear instructions and error messages.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires user interaction, which should be easy and error-free.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must handle up to 10% of invalid or incomplete modification requests without crashing and provide appropriate error messages.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user input, which may be incorrect or incomplete, requiring the system to be robust.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: The system must be able to recover from a failure in the payment gateway within 1 minute and retry the payment process up to 3 times.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves external payment processing, which may fail, requiring the system to handle and recover from such failures.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all sensitive data, including user details and payment information, using AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling sensitive user and payment data, which must be protected.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that all transaction data is stored and transmitted securely, with no data corruption or loss.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves financial transactions, which require data integrity to prevent fraud or errors.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Accountability: The system must log all modification and payment transactions, including timestamps and user identifiers, for audit and compliance purposes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves financial transactions, which require accountability and traceability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Testability: The system must provide unit tests and integration tests for the modification charge calculation and payment processing modules, with a minimum code coverage of 80%.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves complex calculations and external integrations, requiring thorough testing to ensure reliability.

functionalRequirement: The system shall generate a PDF report of all transactions and send a copy to the customer's email address and another copy to the system database for monthly transaction calculation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must generate a PDF report that includes all necessary transaction details (e.g., date, time, amount, user) for 100% of valid transaction records.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to generate a comprehensive report, necessitating full coverage of the required data.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that the PDF report is generated with no missing or incorrect data for 99.9% of valid transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves generating a report that must be accurate for compliance and user trust.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must generate and send the PDF report within 5 seconds for up to 1,000 concurrent transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves generating and sending reports, which should be done quickly to maintain user satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 200 MB of memory to generate and send a single PDF report.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for handling multiple reports and maintaining system performance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and user-friendly interface for users to request and view the PDF report, with clear instructions and error messages.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction, which should be easy and error-free.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must handle up to 5% of failed email deliveries without crashing and provide appropriate error messages.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves external email delivery, which may fail, requiring the system to handle and recover from such failures.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: The system must be able to retry sending the PDF report up to 3 times if the initial email delivery fails, with a 5-minute interval between retries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves external email delivery, which may fail, requiring the system to handle and recover from such failures.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt the PDF report and any transaction data stored in the system database using AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling sensitive transaction data, which must be protected.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that all transaction data stored in the database is consistent and accurate, with no data corruption or loss.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves storing transaction data, which requires data integrity to prevent errors.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Accountability: The system must log all report generation and email sending activities, including timestamps and user identifiers, for audit and compliance purposes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves generating and sending reports, which require accountability and traceability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Testability: The system must provide unit tests and integration tests for the PDF report generation and email sending modules, with a minimum code coverage of 80%.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves generating and sending reports, requiring thorough testing to ensure reliability.
